Chat

Send a chat message and stream the response

Streams text/event-stream. Each frame's data: payload is a ChatStreamEvent (see response model). Frames have event names: session_started, text, done, error. Use fetch() + ReadableStream on the client — EventSource cannot carry an Authorization header.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Chat message

content
required
string [ 1 .. 16384 ] characters

Content is the user's message. Required.

model
string

Model is the specific LLM model ID. Optional.

provider
string

Provider is the LLM provider ID. Optional.

session_id
string

SessionID is the existing session UUID. Empty starts a new session.

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/chat
https://localhost:8080/api/v1/chat

Execute Daily Workflow Transition

Execute a workflow transition using business-readable identifiers and canonical operation types.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Execute payload

accountingDate
string

AccountingDate applies to CLOSE_ACCOUNTING. Format YYYY-MM-DD. When omitted, defaults to BusinessDate.

attestationReason
string

AttestationReason is required when ZeroTransactionAttestation is true (min 30 chars).

businessDate
string

BusinessDate is mandatory; format YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Bangkok calendar).

notes
string

Notes is an optional free-text remark for MANAGER_APPROVE.

operationType
string

OperationType is the canonical API operation name. Valid values: START_INVESTMENT_DAY, CANCEL_INVESTMENT_DAY, MANAGER_APPROVE, CANCEL_MANAGER_APPROVAL, CLOSE_TRANSACTION, CANCEL_TRANSACTION_CLOSE, CLOSE_ACCOUNTING, CANCEL_ACCOUNTING_CLOSE

reason
string

Reason is mandatory for cancel/rollback operations (min 20 chars).

remark
string

Remark is optional free text from the operator. For cancel/rollback operations it is accepted as an alias for reason.

zeroTransactionAttestation
boolean

ZeroTransactionAttestation must be true when approving a day with no investment transactions. Applies to MANAGER_APPROVE only.

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/workflow/daily/execute
https://localhost:8080/api/v1/workflow/daily/execute

Execute Workflow Transition

Execute a workflow transition such as OPEN_DAY, APPROVE, CLOSE_TRANSACTIONS, or ROLLBACK_ACCOUNTING_CLOSE.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
contractId
required
string

Contract UUID

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Transition payload

accountingDate
string

AccountingDate is the NAV / accounting posting date for CLOSE_ACCOUNTING. Format YYYY-MM-DD. When omitted, defaults to BusinessDate. Must not precede BusinessDate. Ignored by other actions.

action
string

Action identifies the transition to execute. Valid values: OPEN_DAY, APPROVE, CANCEL_DAY_START, CANCEL_APPROVAL, CLOSE_TRANSACTIONS, CANCEL_TRANSACTION_CLOSE, CLOSE_ACCOUNTING, ROLLBACK_ACCOUNTING_CLOSE

attestationReason
string

AttestationReason is required when ZeroTransactionAttestation is true. Must be at least 30 characters.

businessDate
string

BusinessDate is mandatory; format YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Bangkok calendar).

idempotencyKey
string

IdempotencyKey is an optional client-generated UUID. When provided, a duplicate request with the same key returns the original result without re-executing the transition. (Full idempotency store is Batch 2.)

notes
string

Notes is an optional free-text remark stored on the approval record. Applies to APPROVE only.

reason
string

Reason is mandatory for cancel and rollback actions (min 20 chars). Optional for forward transitions.

zeroTransactionAttestation
boolean

ZeroTransactionAttestation must be true when approving a day with no investment transactions. Ignored for all other actions.

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/workflow/day-states/{contractId}/transitions
https://localhost:8080/api/v1/workflow/day-states/{contractId}/transitions
